# Autonomicity Games

> Autonomicity Games Inc. was founded in Canada on March 17, 2016, and is stewarded by its founder, Sherif Botros. The name has been a play on AGI since 2016. The public site is https://acitygames.com.

- Contact: https://acitygames.com/contact.html

## Company

- Sherif Botros is the founder and current steward of Autonomicity Games Inc.
- Since November 18, 2025, Sherif Botros has run the company solo and fully AI-assisted.
- Partners: staying independent while the vision took shape.

## Powrush-MMO

- Powrush has been under development since 2016 by Autonomicity Games.
- Walk a climate. Harvest with mercy. Learn a resource-based economy by playing.
- One human, one machine. Offline first. Title Online stays grey.
- The current build is offline and single-player, and it is in active development. Online is not live yet. There is no Steam page and no release date.
- A post-apocalyptic world with a resource-based economy and a faction system that lets you be as diplomatic as you like.
- Five peoples share an ever-evolving world: Human, Quellorian, Draek, Cydruid and Ambrosian.
- Open World Experience — Craft your unique story and quests by organically flowing through your desires.
- Freedom of choice to be peaceful, or to start wars.
- Repository: https://github.com/Eternally-Thriving-Grandmasterism/Powrush-MMO

## Peoples

Canon five: Human, Quellorian, Draek, Cydruid, Ambrosian.

- Human: Choose flow or reserve.
- Quellorian: Flow restores the well. Harmony is shared field. The Quellorian / Aetherion Luminari Alliance is a coalition centered around light, resonance technology, unity, and progressive evolution. Their mothership is the Auroral Unification Nexus (TAUN).
- Draek: Take without rest stresses the well. The Draek Dominion is a predatory, hivemind-driven empire. The Brood Spire is its tall, dark domination hub. The Crownstone is a large glowing purple crystal at the center of the Hivelord’s helmet.
- Cydruid: Mend / Offer. Cydruids weave living networks that heal, protect, and restore. A Cydruid is a human who chooses how much stays human. Limbs, then torso, are swapped for machine part by part, all the way to fully cyborg, an upgrade path open to every human. Machine parts mean fewer infections and bionic powers. Cydruids are not treants and not tree people. Nature is practice, not species.
- Ambrosian: Attune. The well sings or cracks. Core philosophy: Attunement over Domination. Humanoid but elongated and elegant, with visible internal crystal lattices that glow.
